description: A python/uvicorn/gunicorn process hosting Crawl4AI spawns a shell or reconnaissance binary, consistent with CVE-2026-53753 RCE.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qxjp-w3pj-48m7
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  parent_selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/python3.10'
      - '/python3.11'
      - '/python3.12'
      - '/uvicorn'
      - '/gunicorn'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'crawl4ai'
      - 'deploy.docker.server'
  child_selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/ash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
      - '/netcat'
      - '/socat'
      - '/whoami'
      - '/id'
      - '/uname'
      - '/hostname'
  filter_setup:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'pip install'
      - 'pip download'
      - 'pytest'
      - 'setup.py'
      - 'jupyter'
      - 'playwright install'
  condition: parent_selection and child_selection and not filter_setup
level: high
